n.id::text,n.goal_id::text,n.condition_round,n.message_type,n.title,n.content,n.read_at,n.handle_status,n.handled_at,
n.version,n.created_at,n.updated_at,g.version AS goal_version,

AND g.status<>'COMPLETED' AND g.archived_at IS NULL AND g.deleted_at IS NULL,false) AS can_handle
FROM notification_message n LEFT JOIN goal g ON g.id=n.goal_id AND g.user_id=n.user_id

mapper.select:
SELECT g.id AS goal_id,g.name,g.status,g.archived_at,g.deleted_at,g.completion_condition_met,g.completion_round,g.version,
(g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.archived_at IS NULL AND g.status<>'COMPLETED'
AND COALESCE(u.is_enabled,false) AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM identity_user_role ur JOIN identity_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id
WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND r.code='USER' AND r.is_enabled AND r.deleted_at IS NULL)
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM identity_user_role ur JOIN identity_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id
WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND r.code IN('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN') AND r.is_enabled AND r.deleted_at IS NULL)
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stage s JOIN task t ON t.stage_id=s.id AND t.user_id=g.user_id
WHERE s.goal_id=g.id AND s.user_id=g.user_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL)
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stage s JOIN task t ON t.stage_id=s.id AND t.user_id=g.user_id
WHERE s.goal_id=g.id AND s.user_id=g.user_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status<>'COMPLETED')) AS qualifies
FROM goal g LEFT JOIN identity_user u ON u.id=g.user_id WHERE g.user_id=#{userId} AND g.id=#{goalId}

WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{goalId} AND version=#{version}

UPDATE notification_message SET handle_status='INVALIDATED',handled_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now}
WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND goal_id=#{goalId} AND handle_status='PENDING' AND condition_round<>#{keepRound}

UPDATE goal SET completion_condition_met=false,version=version+1,updated_at=#{now}
WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND completion_condition_met

WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND handle_status='PENDING'
